summary: DOMVUS Phase 4 (Owner Portal + 2 security hardening fixes) — end-to-end tested. Backend: 14/14 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_domvus_phase4.py all PASS covering: (1) new GET /api/finance/owner-summary returns full personalized payload for owner (owner_name, totals{balance,outstanding,credit,fractions}, next_due, fractions[], condominiums[], recent_payments[], counts{communications,open_occurrences}) with all fractions scoped to owner's condominium_id; (2) same endpoint returns 403 for property_manager AND super_admin (both non-owner). (3) GET /api/fractions as owner returns only fractions where owner_id == owner's own id — verified count equal to owner's fractions and no leak of neighbor fractions; manager on same condo sees strictly >= that count. (4) GET /api/ops/occurrences as owner: every row's fraction_id belongs to owner's own fraction ids OR the occurrence was reported_by owner; verified no cross-owner leak by comparing with manager's full list on same condo. (5) GET /api/ops/occurrences/{id} for an occurrence on another owner's fraction returns 403/404 (dead-code owner-fraction check in list_occurrences from iteration_3 critical comment now enforced). (6) Documents fix: owner GET /api/ops/documents/{id}/download on condominium-level 'Confidencial' doc → 403; on 'Pessoal' → 403; on 'Regulamento' (non-confidential) same condo → 200 with %PDF bytes; on ANY category in ANOTHER condominium → 403. (7) Owner can still POST /api/ops/occurrences for their own fraction (200) and it appears in their own list. (8) Regression: manager /finance/dashboard, /ops/dashboard, /ops/occurrences 200. Prior suites re-run green: test_domvus_ops.py 18/18 + test_domvus_finance.py 12/12 = 30/30. Frontend (Playwright via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): (a) Owner login (condomino@domvus.pt / Domvus2025!) lands on /dashboard rendering owner-dashboard-page (staff dashboard-page absent). All 8 owner testids present: owner-balance-card, owner-tile-account/occurrences/communications/documents, owner-fractions-card, owner-condo-card, owner-recent-payments. Balance shows 'Conta regularizada 0,00 €' as expected; fraction A101 · Condomínio Jardins do Tejo listed; REC-2026-00001 receipt shown in recent payments. (b) Owner sidebar shows ONLY nav-minha-conta, nav-ocorrencias, nav-comunicacoes, nav-documentos; all 10 staff-only navs (nav-financas, nav-condominios, nav-fracoes, nav-condominos, nav-fornecedores, nav-manutencao, nav-contratos, nav-assembleias, nav-tarefas, nav-utilizadores) confirmed count=0. (c) Owner /comunicacoes: compose-btn count=0 (hidden) and Destinatários column count=0; only owner-addressed communication 'Comunicado — Condomínio Jardins do Tejo' visible. (d) Owner Minha Conta loads with full account ledger. (e) Staff (gestor@domvus.pt): owner-dashboard-page count=0, dashboard-page count=1; nav-financas/condominios visible; compose-btn count=1 and Destinatários column count=1 on Comunicações — staff behavior intact.

issues: Recharts warnings 'ResponsiveContainer width(-1) height(-1)' still logged on first render (cosmetic, from staff dashboard bundle) — pre-existing from iteration_3.

critical_code_review_comments: finance.py owner_summary line 923-926 — open_occurrences count uses org_filter + condominium_id + fraction_id $in ownerFractions, but this excludes common-area (fraction_id=None) occurrences that DO involve the owner's condominium; count under-reports for owners with active common-area tickets. Consider adding {'$or': [{'fraction_id': {'$in': fids}}, {'fraction_id': None}, {'reported_by': user['id']}]} to match the list_occurrences visibility rule.

finance.py owner_summary line 921-922 — 'unread_comms' is actually TOTAL communications addressed to the owner (count_documents with no read/seen filter), not unread; the counts.communications field is misleading. Either rename to 'communications' or add a read-marker query.

finance.py owner_summary line 898 — next_due comparison uses parse_dt(next_due['due_date']) but next_due['due_date'] may originally be a plain date string; if parse_dt returns None the comparison raises. Wrap with a safe key and default to datetime.max.

operations.py _can_access_document — after the confidential/pessoal fix, verify that documents uploaded WITHOUT a category field still default to a safe (owner-blocking) path; empty category should not fall through the 'not in confidential set' branch as accessible.

Comunicacoes.jsx — recipients column hidden via isStaff gate is correct, but the 'target_type' filter on the list-endpoint side should also ensure owner never receives communications where target_type is 'staff' or 'management' regardless of recipient_owner_ids (defensive belt-and-suspenders).

OwnerDashboard.jsx — owner-recent-payments PDF receipt button opens /api/finance/payments/{id}/receipt directly; ensure that endpoint enforces owner_id==payment.owner_id (not just condominium_id) to avoid receipt leakage between owners in the same condo. Backend regression suite should add a targeted test.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 owner portal complete. Suite at /app/backend/tests/test_domvus_phase4.py (~4s). Run alongside test_domvus_ops.py + test_domvus_finance.py for full regression (44 tests, ~12s). For Playwright, cookie is set via login POST; use the same login-then-nav pattern shown here. Notification popover overlay from iteration_3 still present — press Escape before sidebar clicks. Two useful improvement opportunities remain in finance.py owner_summary (see critical_code_review_comments) but do NOT block Phase 4 acceptance.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Both security fixes flagged in iteration_3 (list_occurrences dead owner-fraction check + _can_access_document over-permissive condo docs) verified fixed: owner-only occurrence filter enforced by fraction id set AND cross-owner detail returns 403/404; confidential/pessoal condo-level docs return 403 for owners while non-confidential docs remain accessible in own condo only. New /api/finance/owner-summary endpoint correctly RBAC-guarded (owner-only, staff/super_admin 403).
